summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：P&G與Siemens擴大導入AI視覺檢測，報告指不良品可降20%，凸顯換線需重設視覺檢測的新痛點。另EVAT傳出支持對進口電動車加徵35%稅以保護本地汽車產業，Bosch泰國羅勇廠慶30週年。環保稽查與能源運輸成本壓力持續升溫。
summary_en: P&G and Siemens are expanding AI vision inspection globally, reporting a 20% defect cut, highlighting a new pain: re-setup at changeovers. EVAT reportedly backs a 35% tax on imported EVs; Bosch Thailand marks 30 years in Rayong. Environmental audits and energy costs keep rising.
